import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(g):
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    sep_r, sep_c = set(), set()
    for i, row in enumerate(g):
        if len(set(row)) == 1:
            sep_r.add(i)
    for j in range(w):
        if len({g[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1:
            sep_c.add(j)
    vals = [g[i][j] for i in range(h) if i not in sep_r for j in range(w) if j not in sep_c]
    bg = Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    mark = next((x for x in set(vals) if x != bg), None)
    rbs = [-1] + sorted(sep_r) + [h]
    cbs = [-1] + sorted(sep_c) + [w]
    return [[1 if sum(g[i][j] == mark for i in range(rbs[a]+1, rbs[a+1]) for j in range(cbs[b]+1, cbs[b+1])) >= 2 else bg for b in range(len(cbs)-1)] for a in range(len(rbs)-1)]
'''
open(p,'w').write(source)
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('savedtask',p); mm=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mm)
